# Test script to verify the refactored code
using GeometryBasics

# Test Point3f creation
println("Testing Point3f...")
p1 = Point3f(1.0, 2.0, 3.0)
p2 = Point3f(4.0, 5.0, 6.0)
p3 = p1 + p2
println("p1 = $p1")
println("p2 = $p2")
println("p1 + p2 = $p3")

# Test vector of Point3f
xyz = [Point3f(i, j, k) for i in 1:2, j in 1:2, k in 1:2]
xyz_flat = vec(xyz)
println("\nFlat xyz vector length: $(length(xyz_flat))")
println("First element: $(xyz_flat[1])")

# Test scalar multiplication
scalar = 2.5
result = scalar .* p1
println("\nScalar multiplication: $scalar * $p1 = $result")

# Test that we can extract components
x_coords = [p[1] for p in xyz_flat]
y_coords = [p[2] for p in xyz_flat]
z_coords = [p[3] for p in xyz_flat]
println("\nExtracted x coords: $x_coords")
println("Extracted y coords: $y_coords")
println("Extracted z coords: $z_coords")

println("\n✓ All basic tests passed!")
